text:
The core is working: start-up passes and every core device is saturated. M6 and the MSD stack in triode is intended, since that is the sense node pulled high. TC misses by only 4% (1777 vs 1700 ppm/C) because the PTAT term is too small for the CTAT slope.

Raising Vptat from 0.21 to 0.27 V should add about 0.2 mV/C, bringing TC to roughly 1450 ppm/C. A slightly higher I and Mq = 1 raise V_EB, which makes its negative TC smaller. Both stay inside the vref and power limits.
